weekLabel: Week of Jul 6 - 12 · refreshed Sun Jul 5. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: World Cup Quarter-Final at Gillette
events.meta: Ticketed (steep) · Gillette Stadium, Foxborough. Match 97, the last World Cup game in New England and one of only four quarter-finals in North America (teams set by the bracket). Tickets and parking are brutal, so the family play is a watch party or a bar with the game on for Dave & Alex. Kickoff 4pm ET Thu Jul 9. source

events.name: North Shore Concert Band at Salem Willows
events.meta: Free · Salem Willows Park, Salem. Free "Broadway Favorites" concert on the oceanfront, 7-9pm, with the arcade, rides, and snack stands right there for the kids. Ocean plus live musical-theater tunes is a whole-family win. Go early for parking near the pavilion. source

events.name: Infinity Song at Prescott Park
events.meta: Suggested donation (verify amount) · Prescott Park, Portsmouth NH. Roc Nation soul/R&B group Infinity Song on the Wilcox Main Stage, 7pm, right on the Piscataqua waterfront. Bring chairs and a picnic, pair with a Portsmouth dinner. source

events.name: Cinderella at Prescott Park
events.meta: Suggested donation (verify amount) · Prescott Park, Portsmouth NH. The festival's big outdoor summer musical, Rodgers & Hammerstein's Cinderella, under the stars on the waterfront. Made for KK and Isabella; blanket seating, come early for a good spot. Fri Jul 10 at 7pm (Thu Jul 9 is ASL-supported, plus Sun matinees). source

events.name: Salisbury Beach Oceanfront Concert
events.meta: Free · Salisbury Beach Oceanfront Stage. The Partnership runs a free concert every Saturday at 7:30pm on the beachfront stage all summer, with fireworks on select Saturdays (~10:15pm). Check the calendar for this week's act and whether Jul 11 is a fireworks night (verify). Easy beach evening for all five. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · 500 Harrison Ave, South End Boston. 175+ makers, ~20 food trucks, a vintage market and an outdoor beer garden with live music and lawn games on pedestrian-only Thayer St. Stacey's city-day pick, easy to graze and bail. source

events.name: Revolution vs Toronto FC
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium, Foxborough. MLS restarts after the World Cup break and the Revs come home for back-to-back nights: Toronto FC Wed Jul 22, then Atlanta United Sat Jul 25, both 7:30pm. A more affordable live-soccer night for Dave & Alex than the World Cup. source

events.name: Boston Landmarks Orchestra - Hatch Shell
events.meta: Free · DCR Hatch Shell, Charles River Esplanade. The 25th-anniversary season of free orchestral concerts under the stars opens Wed Jul 22 with "The Best of Boston," Christopher Wilkins conducting. Bring a blanket. Runs Wednesdays through Aug 12. source

events.name: Yarmouth Clam Festival - Maine
events.meta: Free entry · Yarmouth ME. Classic Maine seafood weekend: fried clams, the big parade, live music, midway. Dave bait, worth the drive. Confirm the 2026 dates on the official site (verify). source

events.when: Trampled by Turtles Jul 26; The Head and the Heart Aug 2
events.name: Thompson's Point Concerts - Portland ME
events.meta: Ticketed · Portland ME waterfront. Summer shows worth booking ahead: Trampled by Turtles Jul 26, The Head and the Heart Aug 2, Guster Aug 8-9, Lake Street Dive Aug 15-16. Good one for KK if any land right. source

events.name: Maine Lobster Festival - Rockland
events.meta: Ticketed grounds · Rockland ME. 79th year: lobster every way, the big parade, live music on the bay. A full-day-plus trip, but peak Maine summer. source
